assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game character modeling reference, face and hair identity sheet
Primary request: Create a polished semi-realistic modeling reference sheet for the exact same protagonist shown in the references.
Input images: Image 1 is the primary identity, mood, hairstyle and silhouette reference; Image 2 is secondary anatomy and clothing-proportion reference only.
Subject: an ordinary Chinese male university student in his early twenties, average-to-slim non-heroic build, attentive and slightly guarded neutral expression, short dark tousled layered hair, brick-red short-sleeve shirt visible only at the collar and shoulders.
Style/medium: original-art faithful semi-realistic game character concept, believable human anatomy and skin, not photorealistic, suitable for Blender sculpting.
Composition/framing: one clean reference sheet containing exactly five consistent views of the same head at the same scale: orthographic front, left profile, back hair view, left three-quarter, right three-quarter. Keep the face fully visible and the hair silhouette readable.
Lighting/mood: flat neutral studio lighting with a gentle warm rim, medium-gray background, no dramatic shadows.
Materials/textures: natural young skin with restrained detail; solid layered hair clumps suitable for opaque 3D geometry.
Constraints: preserve the recognizable narrow almond eyes, straight brows, modest jaw, youthful face, short tousled fringe and quiet observant personality from Image 1; all five views must be the same person; no redesign; no facial hair; no glasses; no accessories; no text; no labels; no watermark.
Avoid: celebrity likeness, heroic jaw, muscular neck, anime exaggeration, oversized eyes, glossy plastic skin, helmet-shaped hair, duplicated heads beyond the five requested views, cropped hair or chin.
